name: NovaBank
about: NovaBank is a UK digital bank building fair, transparent everyday banking. Engineering-led, hybrid-first, with squads owning products end to end.

name: Thames Logistics
about: Thames Logistics runs distribution and fulfilment for UK retailers from five sites across the North and Midlands. People stay because progression is real: most site leaders started on the floor.

name: BrightCare Group
about: BrightCare operates 40 care homes and a growing home-care service across the North West. CQC-rated Good or Outstanding in 92% of services.

name: Kelpie Energy
about: Kelpie Energy develops and operates onshore wind and battery storage across Scotland. Engineering, project delivery and commercial teams hybrid out of Edinburgh.

name: Harper & Vale
about: Harper & Vale is a regional law firm known for commercial property and private client work — and for actually meaning it about work-life balance.

name: Plumline
about: Plumline is a direct-to-consumer homeware brand selling across the UK and EU. Small teams, big ownership, quarterly profit-share.

name: Orchard Schools Trust
about: A multi-academy trust of 14 primary and secondary schools across the East Midlands, with a shared curriculum team and genuine ECT support.

name: Ferrocast Engineering
about: Precision castings and machined components for rail and energy. Apprenticeship-grown workforce; day shift and continental patterns.

name: CityMed Partners
about: Private GP and occupational health provider serving London employers, with clinics in the City, Canary Wharf and Westfield.

name: Meridian Media
about: Meridian produces digital content and podcasts for UK brands, with an in-house paid-media team trading seven figures annually.

name: Grayline Construct
about: Main contractor delivering commercial and infrastructure projects across Wales and the South West. Frameworks with two water companies and the Welsh Government.

name: Fintor
about: Fintor builds accounting automation for UK SMEs. Remote-first with quarterly meetups; salaries published on every role since day one.

name: Hudson Analytics
about: Hudson Analytics builds risk and fraud tooling for US banks and fintechs. NYC-hybrid engineering and data teams; every posting carries a published pay range.

name: GoldenGate Health
about: GoldenGate Health operates outpatient clinics across California and Washington, with clinical, operations and telehealth teams hiring year-round.

name: Lonestar Logistics
about: Lonestar runs fulfillment and freight across Texas and the Southeast. Floor-to-leadership progression is real — most site directors started on a forklift.

name: Beacon Hill Legal
about: A Boston litigation and corporate boutique known for actually sustainable billable targets and real mentorship for associates and paralegals.

name: Cascade Renewables
about: Cascade develops wind, solar and storage across the Pacific Northwest and Mountain West. Engineering, project delivery and commercial teams, Seattle-hybrid.

name: Peachtree Media
about: Peachtree produces branded content and paid social for consumer brands, with an in-house media team trading eight figures annually.
